lines.en: label day543:
scene returnofthemakoto1
: Sensei! Sensei! Guess what!
lines.zh: : Sensei！Sensei！猜猜看！

lines.en: My morning begins the same way as always- with a small girl running up to me and begging for some time alone with my penis.
lines.zh: 我的早晨一如既往地开始——一个小女孩跑到我面前，求我跟我的阴茎独处一会儿。

lines.en: : Hah...fine. But we can’t do it in the classroom and will have to use my office.
lines.zh: : 哈……行吧。不过我们不能在教室里做，得去我的办公室。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto2
: Office? What? Am I in trouble?
lines.zh: : 办公室？什么？我是不是惹麻烦了？

lines.en: : No. I just got ahead of myself and misinterpreted whatever it is you’re looking for. But go ahead, Miku. I will allow you to talk as an apology for my...incorrectness.
lines.zh: : 不是。是我自己想太多了，误解了你找我到底想要什么。不过说吧，Miku。作为我……判断失误的赔礼，我允许你说。

lines.en: : Why’re you bein’ so weird today?
lines.zh: : 你今天怎么怪怪的？

lines.en: : It’s my hot boy summer. I’m allowed.
lines.zh: : 这是我的热辣男孩之夏。我有这个特权。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto1
: Well, I’ve got no idea what the heck ya mean by that, but I’ve got some great news!
lines.zh: : 呃，我不知道你到底在说啥，但我有个超棒的消息！

lines.en: : Great for me or great for you? Because those are two very different things.
lines.zh: : 对我棒还是对你棒？因为这两者可是完全不同的两码事。

lines.en: : Both of us!
lines.zh: : 对我们俩都棒！

lines.en: : Great for me because I won’t be so bored anymore...and great for you since you won’t have to do all of that paperwork you’re always complainin’ about!
lines.zh: : 对我棒，是因为我不会再那么无聊了……对你棒，是因为你再也不用做那些你天天抱怨的文书工作了！

lines.en: : Wait...does that mean-
lines.zh: : 等等……你的意思是——

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto3
: Makoto’s waitin’ in the hall right now. Maki drove the two of us to school today after takin’ us out for breakfast.
lines.zh: : Makoto 现在就在走廊里等着呢。今天早上 Maki 带我们俩出去吃了早饭，然后开车送我们来学校。

lines.en: : She’s finally ready?
lines.zh: : 她终于准备好了？

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto4
: Wanna come see for yourself? Figured you’d wanna talk to her anyway.
lines.zh: : 想自己出来看看不？我猜你本来也想跟她谈谈。

lines.en: : Plus, she’s trying to keep everything lowkey right now- which would give me time to go around and remind everybody not to say anything that might upset her.
lines.zh: : 再说，她现在正想尽量低调——这样我就有时间到处去提醒大家，别说任何可能让她难受的话。

lines.en: : I don’t really want to go out there if she’s not expecting me to come out. The two of us left off in...kind of a weird spot.
lines.zh: : 如果她没想到我会出去，我其实不太想就这么出去。我们上次分开的时候……状况有点怪。

lines.en: : She is expectin’ you, though. And, as her best friend, I can safely say she’d probs be a lot more comfortable comin’ back to class knowin’ you’ll be by her side.
lines.zh: : 可她在等你啊。而且作为她最好的朋友，我可以肯定地说，要是知道回班后你会陪在她身边，她大概会自在得多。

lines.en: : I haven’t been by her side at all. And while I’m obviously not blaming myself for what happened, I can’t imagine I helped in any way.
lines.zh: : 我根本没陪在她身边过。虽然我显然不是在替发生的事情自责，但我也想象不出我帮上了什么忙。

lines.en: : Well, why are you sayin’ all of that to me? Ain’t no way I’m gonna remember it. Just come out in the hallway and tell it to her straight while I work my Miku magic.
lines.zh: : 那你跟我说这些干啥？我肯定记不住的。直接去走廊，当面跟她说清楚，我去施展我的 Miku 魔法。

lines.en: So...Makoto is back.
lines.zh: 所以……Makoto 回来了。

lines.en: I guess now is as good a time as any with the class suddenly abuzz about Halloween being right around the corner.
lines.zh: 全班突然都在热议万圣节就快到了，我想现在大概是个合适的时机。

lines.en: But...then again, I worry that might evoke some unhelpful memories for Makoto as I don’t exactly have a history of being “kind” to her on that day.
lines.zh: 但……话说回来，我又担心这会勾起 Makoto 一些不好的回忆，因为那一天我对她可算不上“善良”。

lines.en: Maybe I’m looking back on that first Halloween with tinted glasses and Makoto doesn’t feel as broken up about it as I have recently.
lines.zh: 也许我是戴着滤镜在回看第一个万圣节，Makoto 其实并不像我最近这样对它那么介怀。

lines.en: But I’ve already decided-
lines.zh: 但我已经决定了——

lines.en: I am going to be better to her.
lines.zh: 我要对她好一点。

lines.en: I’m going to stop pretending I understand what she needs as I’ve been nothing but wrong this whole time and look where that’s gotten us.
lines.zh: 我要停止假装自己知道她需要什么，因为这段时间我一直是错的，看看我们走到了哪一步。

lines.en: And sure, it’s easy to say that now that she’s jumped the biggest hurdle she’ll ever face- but being late is better than never showing up at all.
lines.zh: 当然，她已经跨过了她这辈子最大的那道坎，我现在说这话确实轻松——但迟到总比永远不到场要好。

lines.en: And sometimes it takes a horrible tragedy for us to find out what’s important.
lines.zh: 而且有时候，我们得经历一场可怕的悲剧，才能明白什么才是重要的。

lines.en: scene imaginarybird
scene returnofthemakoto5
: Kay! We’re back. Still feelin’ up to the challenge?
lines.zh: : 好啦！我们回来了。还撑得住吗？

lines.en: : I’ve been away for long enough...the absences are getting hard to justify at this point.
lines.zh: : 我已经离开太久了……再缺席下去，到了这个地步已经很难交代了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure it’s up to me to determine whether or not the absences are justified or not.
lines.zh: : 缺席到底合不合理，我觉得应该由我来判定吧。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto6
: That is most certainly not how it works.
lines.zh: : 事情绝对不是这么运作的。

lines.en: : Either way, if you’re not feeling up to the task-
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，如果你觉得撑不住——

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto7
: I’m fine. Well...I’m not fine. But I’m fine enough to be “up to the task.”
lines.zh: : 我没事。嗯……我不没事。但我够“撑得住”了。

lines.en: : Or at least partially up to the task. I don’t know. I'm fucking miserable.
lines.zh: : 或者至少部分撑得住。我不知道。我他妈难受死了。

lines.en: : But it’s not going to get any better by sitting in my room all day.
lines.zh: : 但整天坐在自己房间里，情况也不会好转。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto8
: In fact...heh...I’m not entirely convinced it’s going to get better at all.
lines.zh: : 事实上……呵……我甚至不太确信它到底会不会好起来。

lines.en: : But if coming back is what makes everyone else happy...if coming back can make both my mother and Miku feel more comfortable with the fact that I’m completely fucking broken now-
lines.zh: : 但如果回来能让其他人高兴……如果回来能让我母亲和 Miku 更坦然地接受我如今已经彻底他妈碎掉了这个事实——

lines.en: : Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto9
: Right...sorry.
lines.zh: : 对……抱歉。

lines.en: : Look after her, okay? I’ll be back in a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 照顾好她，行吗？我几分钟后就回来。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto10
Miku runs back into the classroom, leaving me alone with Makoto’s body and the seed of grief that has taken root within it.
lines.zh: Miku 跑回教室，留下我独自面对 Makoto 的身体，以及那具身体里已经生根的悲叹之种。

lines.en: She looks mostly the same. Her voice is mostly the same- just maybe an octave deeper.
lines.zh: 她看起来大致没什么变化。声音也大致一样——也许只是低了一个八度。

lines.en: But the way she stares down at the ground when she talks...the way she nervously grips her suspenders and...blinks at an elevated rate as if she’s been stricken with some sort of ocular arrhythmia-
lines.zh: 但她说话时低头盯着地面的样子……紧张地攥着背带、还有……以异常的频率眨着眼，像是患上了某种眼部心律失常——

lines.en: None of that is her.
lines.zh: 这些都不是她。

lines.en: Or the old her, at least.
lines.zh: 至少，不是以前的那个她。

lines.en: I still have to get to know this new one.
lines.zh: 我还得重新认识这个新的她。

lines.en: But the fact that she’s been reborn gives us another connection...or one more outlet to sink our prongs into so we’re not forced to sink them into each other anymore.
lines.zh: 但她获得重生这件事给了我们另一层联系……或者说多了一个可以把倒刺扎进去的地方，这样我们就不必再被迫把倒刺扎向彼此了。

lines.en: : It’s been rough here without you.
lines.zh: : 你不在的这段时间，这里挺难熬的。

lines.en: : I imagine the school would be without you as well if it weren’t for Miss Imai stepping up to the plate while I was away.
lines.zh: : 我想，如果没有 Imai 老师在我离开期间顶上来，学校没有你大概也一样难熬。

lines.en: : Probably. You should be proud knowing that I actually did work a little, though.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。不过知道我真的干了一点活，你应该感到骄傲。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto11
: You? Really? You expect me to believe that?
lines.zh: : 你？真的？你指望我相信这个？

lines.en: : No. But I expect to prove it to you.
lines.zh: : 不。但我指望向你证明。

lines.en: : And that means...what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那意味着……什么，具体来说？

lines.en: : Makoto Miyamura...you are hereby relieved of your duties as my assistant and are now free to focus on enjoying your high school life.
lines.zh: : Makoto Miyamura……我在此解除你作为我助手的职务，你现在可以自由地去享受你的高中生活了。

lines.en: : Is this you pretending to be nice to me or something?
lines.zh: : 这是你在假装对我好，还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I’m not pretending. I really do want to start taking it easy on you.
lines.zh: : 我没在假装。我是真的想开始对你宽松一点。

lines.en: : By taking away something I actually like doing?
lines.zh: : 通过夺走一件我其实喜欢做的事？

lines.en: : Do you actually like doing all of that work? Or do you just like being of use to me?
lines.zh: : 你是真的喜欢做那些工作？还是你只是喜欢对我有用？

lines.en: : Both.
lines.zh: : 两个都是。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Then, by all means. But this gesture of mine should not go unnoticed since I’ve been actively dreading having to say all of that to you.
lines.zh: : 那么请便吧。但我这份心意不该被你视而不见，毕竟我可是一直在发愁要不要对你说这些。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto12
: Thank you, Sensei. Though, I’d like to give this “nice” side of yours a little more time to settle in as I have a hard time comprehending exactly what that entails.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei。不过，我想给你这个“温柔”的一面多一点时间沉淀，因为我很难理解它到底意味着什么。

lines.en: : It entails not taking advantage of you anymore, for one.
lines.zh: : 它意味着，至少，我不再利用你了。

lines.en: : Does that include or exclude sexual contact?
lines.zh: : 这包不包括性接触？

lines.en: : Hopefully, it excludes it. I quite enjoy having sex with you. Which is a thing I probably shouldn’t be saying in the hall during school hours, but hey.
lines.zh: : 希望是不包括。我跟你做爱可是相当享受的。这种话我大概不该在上课时间的走廊里说，不过，嘿。

lines.en: : Daring as ever, I see.
lines.zh: : 还是一如既往地大胆啊。

lines.en: if makotolust30 == True:
: Says the girl who straight up forced herself on me when I came over to talk to her in her time of need.
lines.zh: : 这话可是一个在我去她最需要人的时候找她谈话、结果直接强上了我的女孩说出来的。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto13
: Wha-
: Did that...
lines.zh: : 那件事……

lines.en: : Did that actually happen?...
lines.zh: : 那件事是真的发生了吗？……

lines.en: : It did.
lines.zh: : 是真的。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto14
: Oh my god...oh my god oh my god oh my god...
lines.zh: : 哦我的天……哦我的天哦我的天哦我的天……

lines.en: : I...have memories of that but...I could have sworn it was a dream.
lines.zh: : 我……有那件事的记忆，但……我明明可以发誓那只是个梦。

lines.en: : Are you always a rapist in your dreams or did I just get lucky?
lines.zh: : 你在梦里一直都是强奸犯，还是只是我运气好？

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto15
: I...am so sorry...oh my god...I don’t even know what to say...
lines.zh: : 我……非常抱歉……哦天哪……我甚至不知道该说什么……

lines.en: : That was...That was a really weird time for me and-
lines.zh: : 那真是……那对我来说真是一段很奇怪的日子，而且——

lines.en: : Apology accepted. Let’s move on.
lines.zh: : 道歉接受。我们翻篇吧。

lines.en: : But, Sensei...I did something absolutely unforgivable to you and-
lines.zh: : 可是，Sensei……我对你做了一件绝对不可饶恕的事，而且——

lines.en: : I said let’s move on.
lines.zh: : 我说了，翻篇。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto16
: To...what exactly?
lines.zh: : 翻到……什么，具体来说？

lines.en: : To what you’re going to do from here on out, I guess.
lines.zh: : 翻到从今往后你要做的事，我想。

lines.en: else:
: Yeah, you know me- completely immune to anyone overhearing anything that could potentially get me into trouble.
lines.zh: : 对，你知道我的——对任何可能被别人听去、让我惹上麻烦的事完全免疫。

lines.en: : So, what are you going to do from here on out? Is there anything I can do for you?
lines.zh: : 所以，从今往后你打算怎么办？有什么我能为你做的吗？

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto17
: Right now, I...
lines.zh: : 现在，我……

lines.en: : I just want to get my attendance back to normal...
lines.zh: : 我只想把出勤恢复正常……

lines.en: : I’m going to apologize to everyone individually for my outburst when I, uhh...pre-emptively came back to class before, but...
lines.zh: : 我要为之前那次……呃……提前回班时的情绪失控，向每个人单独道歉，不过……

lines.en: : For now, I kind of want to be as invisible as possible.
lines.zh: : 现在，我有点想尽量隐形。

lines.en: : Then invisibility it is. Thankfully, I’m pretty sure Miku is in the process of making that dream of yours a reality right now.
lines.zh: : 那就隐形吧。幸好，我敢肯定 Miku 现在正在把你的这个梦想变成现实。

lines.en: : Dream’s already come true, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 梦想已经成真啦，Sensei！

lines.en: : Makoto, the runway’s all set and you’re cleared for landing. Whenever you’re ready, I mean. Feel free to keep hoverin’ out here with Sensei if ya...I don’t know. I’m fresh outta plane terms.
lines.zh: : Makoto，跑道已经清空，可以降落了。我的意思是，你什么时候准备好都行。要是你想继续跟 Sensei 在外面盘旋，随你……我不知道。我的飞机术语用完了。

lines.en: : Okay...I’ll...I’ll be there in a second.
lines.zh: : 好……我……我马上就进去。

lines.en: : You nervous?
lines.zh: : 你紧张？

lines.en: : Yeah...because I know what they’re going to think.
lines.zh: : 嗯……因为我知道她们会怎么想。

lines.en: : They’re going to pity me...and...and they’re going to feel uncomfortable...
lines.zh: : 她们会可怜我……而且……而且她们会觉得不自在……

lines.en: : Probably. But at least you won’t be the only one feeling out of place.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。但至少不是只有你一个人感到格格不入。

lines.en: : Even if...Even if I am nervous...and worried...and all sorts of other things...
lines.zh: : 就算……就算我很紧张……很担心……还有各种别的情绪……

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto18
: I don’t think I’ll...ever feel out of place here.
lines.zh: : 我大概也……永远不会觉得自己不属于这里。

lines.en: scene black
scene returnofthemakoto19
Makoto shields herself from the unintentionally prying eyes of her classmates by gripping the back of my blazer and slipping into the room right after me.
lines.zh: Makoto 抓着我西装外套的后摆，紧跟着我溜进教室，以此躲开同学们无意间投来的探询目光。

lines.en: Then, like second nature, she retreats to her desk and removes a notebook that I assume has been sitting in there since she was called down to the front office.
lines.zh: 然后，像是出于本能，她退回自己的座位，拿出一本笔记本——我猜从她被叫去教务处那天起，它就一直躺在那里。

lines.en: I wonder what the last thing she wrote is.
lines.zh: 我在想她最后写下的东西是什么。

lines.en: I wonder if the page she’s looking at right now has anything written on it at all...or if she’s just trying to make it look like she’s reading so no one bothers her.
lines.zh: 我在想她此刻盯着的那页上面到底有没有写东西……还是说她只是在装出看书的模样，好让没人来烦她。

lines.en: As you may have expected, there’s a brief moment of silence as the rest of the girls glance over at her in unison.
lines.zh: 如你所料，有那么一瞬间，其余的女生齐刷刷地看向她，教室里一片安静。

lines.en: But the silence clears up when Miku stares back at them.
lines.zh: 但 Miku 回瞪了她们一眼，沉默就散了。

lines.en: And within less than a minute, it’s like nothing ever changed.
lines.zh: 不到一分钟，一切就像从没变过一样。

lines.en: But I wonder how those few seconds felt to her.
lines.zh: 但我在想，那几秒钟对她来说是什么感觉。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto20
: Ayane...
lines.zh: : Ayane……

lines.en: : Uta...
lines.zh: : Uta……

lines.en: : Are you thinking what I’m thinking?
lines.zh: : 你在想的事，跟我在想的事一样吗？

lines.en: : That four Senseis at once might not be that bad with a good amount of foreplay?
lines.zh: : 是说只要前戏够足，同时来四个 Sensei 也许没那么糟？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Wait, what-
lines.zh: : 等等，什么——

lines.en: : That it’s time to begin preparations for Operation: Phoenix?
lines.zh: : 是说该开始筹备“凤凰行动”了？

lines.en: : Bingo.
lines.zh: : 答对了。

lines.en: : Just to make sure, though...Operation: Phoenix is code for the second annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars, right?
lines.zh: : 不过先确认一下……“凤凰行动”是第二届超级无敌究极宿舍大战的代号，对吧？

lines.en: : Right. Because the first one was Operation: Firestarter and the fire ended when the contest did. And Phoenixes are made of fire or something and then rise from the ashes.
lines.zh: : 对。因为第一届是“纵火行动”，火随着比赛结束而熄灭。而凤凰大概是由火构成的什么玩意儿，还能从灰烬里重生。

lines.en: : So obviously, the second annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars have to involve Phoenixes in some way.
lines.zh: : 所以显然，第二届超级无敌究极宿舍大战必须以某种方式跟凤凰扯上关系。

lines.en: : You put a lot of thought into that. I like it. Gives me extra fodder for when I beat your ass again this year.
lines.zh: : 你在这上面花了不少心思。我喜欢。这给我今年再把你打得落花流水提供了额外素材。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto21
: Yeah, maybe don’t comment on my virginity this time if we wind up facing off against each other, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这次要是我们正面对上，也许别再拿我的处女身份说事了。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...yeah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……是啊……

lines.en: : Facing off against each other in what?
lines.zh: : 正面对上什么？

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto22
: Is that really the part of Ayane’s last sentence you’re most concerned about?
lines.zh: : Ayane 最后那句话里，你最在意的真的是这个部分？

lines.en: : Who do you think I am? The boner police? Ayane’s a powerful, independent woman who can have sex with whoever she wants.
lines.zh: : 你把我当成什么人了？管别人勃起的警察？Ayane 是个强大独立的女性，她想跟谁做爱就跟谁做爱。

lines.en: : Thanks, Imani. You’re always so uplifting.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Imani。你总是这么让人振作。

lines.en: : So, this face-off thing...what’s the deal? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 那这个正面对上的事……到底怎么回事？在搞什么？

lines.en: : Just some contest thing we had last year where the first floor girls went up against the second floor girls for the grand prize of...Sensei.
lines.zh: : 就是我们去年搞过的一个比赛，一楼的女生对上二楼的女生，大奖是……Sensei。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto23
: Yo, is that why every single one of you is obsessed with him? The lingering desire to prove your counterparts on the opposing floor wrong?
lines.zh: : 哟，这就是你们每个人都对他着迷的原因？想证明对面楼层那帮人是错的这种挥之不去的欲望？

lines.en: : No. We just think he’s really hot and caring and a bunch of other good things normal people can’t really see.
lines.zh: : 不是。我们只是觉得他真的很帅、很体贴，还有一堆普通人看不出来的优点。

lines.en: : I don’t like anyone. Not me. No siree.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢任何人。我可不喜欢。绝对没有。

lines.en: : Oh.
scene returnofthemakoto24
: Well, either way! That sounds fun as Hell and I want in! How are we doing this? Where are we doing this? And, important question, am I allowed to win?
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管怎样！听起来他妈的好玩，我要参加！我们怎么搞？在哪儿搞？还有，重要问题，允许我赢吗？

lines.en: : We do it all over the place! But, for an added layer of fun, we were thinking of combining it with Halloween this year and getting two parties out of the way in one!
lines.zh: : 我们到处都搞！不过为了多一层乐趣，我们打算今年把它跟万圣节合在一起，一次搞定两场派对！

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto25
: Ahh, yes...Halloween...
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊……万圣节……

lines.en: : I can finally wear a school uniform without anyone telling me I’m being inappropriate.
lines.zh: : 我终于可以穿校服，而没人说我不得体了。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re allowed to win, though, since you don’t live on either of the floors. But if Sensei is okay with it, you can probably help him judge and-
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得你不能赢，因为你既不住一楼也不住二楼。但如果 Sensei 同意的话，你大概可以帮他当评委，然后——

lines.en: scene black
: SENPAI!
lines.zh: : SENPAI！

lines.en: : Ooooh, and Miss Imani Imai gets off to a quick start! Defying all expectations in her rookie season and sprinting across the court to her target!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，Imani Imai 老师起跑迅猛！新秀赛季就打破所有预期，冲过球场扑向她的目标！

lines.en: : But will she be able to land her punches, Uta?! Will the field goal be good?!
lines.zh: : 但她能不能打中呢，Uta？！这记射门会进吗？！

lines.en: : What sport are we even commentating on?!
lines.zh: : 我们到底在解说什么运动啊？！

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto26
: SENPAI! SENPAI SENPAI SENPAI!
lines.zh: : SENPAI！SENPAI SENPAI SENPAI！

lines.en: : Fine. But I’ll tell you the same thing I told Miku. It has to be in my office.
lines.zh: : 行。但我跟你说跟 Miku 一样的话。得在我的办公室里。

lines.en: : I ain’t looking for no break time hanky-panky!
lines.zh: : 我可不是来找你在休息时间乱搞的！

lines.en: : When did all of you start being such buzzkills? This is the worst hot boy summer ever.
lines.zh: : 你们什么时候都变成这种扫兴鬼了？这真是有史以来最糟糕的热辣男孩之夏。

lines.en: : Let me judge the Dorm Wars with you!
lines.zh: : 让我跟你一起当宿舍大战的评委吧！

lines.en: : The Dorm Wars? Are we doing that again?
lines.zh: : 宿舍大战？我们又要搞那个了？

lines.en: : Either that or I am being hazed and deceived! And I’m pretty sure everybody likes me too much at this point to haze me!
lines.zh: : 要么就是这个，要么就是我在被整蛊、被骗！而且我敢肯定大家现在都太喜欢我了，不会整我！

lines.en: : What if our decision is split and we choose different people?
lines.zh: : 要是我们意见分歧，选了不同的人呢？

lines.en: : Then you and I will argue with each other until one of us changes our mind!
lines.zh: : 那你我就吵到其中一个改主意为止！

lines.en: : That sounds unnecessarily complicated for something I could just decide on my own.
lines.zh: : 为了一件我本来自己就能决定的事，这听起来没必要地复杂。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto27
: Pweeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeease?
lines.zh: : 求求求求求求求求求求求求求你了？

lines.en: : Why are you talking like that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么说话？

lines.en: : Pwetty pwease? Wit a widdle cherry on top?
lines.zh: : 求求你了嘛？再在上面加颗小樱桃？

lines.en: : On top of what, you fucking weirdo?
lines.zh: : 加在什么上面，你这个死变态？

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto26
: Damn it, Senpai! It’s no fun if only you have fun!
lines.zh: : 该死，Senpai！只有你一个人开心就不好玩了！

lines.en: : I don’t know. That sounds like fun to me.
lines.zh: : 我可不知道。我觉得那听起来挺好玩的。

lines.en: : If you don’t let me judge this contest with you...then...then...
lines.zh: : 如果你不让我跟你一起当这个比赛的评委……那……那……

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto28
: I’ll tell everybody what you did to me in the school locker room after swim club practice!
lines.zh: : 我就把你在游泳社训练之后、在学校更衣室里对我做的事告诉所有人！

lines.en: : Gasp. Sensei, how could you? And after I went out of my way to invite you...
lines.zh: : 惊。Sensei，你怎么能这样？我还特意去邀请了你呢……

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s a rumor you really want to start, Imani. Some of these girls would rip you to shreds.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这不是你真想散布的谣言，Imani。这些女孩里有些人会把你撕成碎片。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I kind of want Imani to rip me to shreds.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我倒挺想被 Imani 撕成碎片的。

lines.en: : SEEEEEENPAAAAAIIIIIII!
lines.zh: : SEEEEEENPAAAAAIIIIIII！

lines.en: : Fine, Jesus. But I reserve the right to judge any unofficial bonus contests on my own.
lines.zh: : 行，天哪。但我保留自行评判任何非正式加赛的权利。

lines.en: scene returnofthemakoto29
: What’s an unofficial bonus contest? I’m not familiar with this whole process yet.
lines.zh: : 什么是非正式加赛？我对这整套流程还不熟。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Oh, good. The second period bell. Time to ignore my student teacher and go wander around the hallway.
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了。第二节课的铃。是时候无视我的实习老师，去走廊里闲逛了。

lines.en: scene black
: Oh, no you don’t! Get back here, grand prize man!
lines.zh: : 哦不，你别想！给我回来，头奖男人！

lines.en: Imani (Who is much faster than me) quickly tracks me down, but stops pressing on the matter of “unofficial bonus contests” when her adult brain sends her a signal as to what that might mean.
lines.zh: Imani（比我快得多）很快就追上了我，但当她成年人的大脑向她发出信号、提示那可能意味着什么之后，她就不再追问“非正式加赛”的事了。

lines.en: I support her decision to slip into blissful ignorance but, despite having agreed to it already, I’m not quite sure how I feel about her decision to join me as a judge.
lines.zh: 我支持她选择滑进幸福的无知里，但尽管已经答应了她，我对她要跟我一起当评委这件事，还是不太确定自己是什么感受。

lines.en: In an ideal world, she’d team up with all of the other adults I know for a mega three-tiered battle in which they create their own third floor, but...
lines.zh: 在理想世界里，她会和我认识的那些成年人组起队来，打一场三层楼级别的超级大乱斗——她们自己造出个第三层楼来，不过……

lines.en: Actually, that sounds like pure chaos.
lines.zh: 实际上，那听起来纯属一团混乱。

lines.en: The bonus contests would probably be fun, though.
lines.zh: 不过加赛大概会很有意思。

lines.en: Assuming there...are any of them this year, that is.
lines.zh: 前提是……今年真有的话，那就是。

lines.en: But hey, there’s only one way to find out and it sounds like it’s right around the corner at this point.
lines.zh: 但嘿，只有一种办法能知道答案，而且听起来它现在已经近在眼前了。

lines.en: All that’s left to do is wait and...
lines.zh: 剩下的就只有等待，然后……

lines.en: Worry about what will happen to me if I am once again split between ten girls crammed into a small room.
lines.zh: 担心如果再次被十个挤在小房间里的女生瓜分，我会变成什么样。

lines.en: $ day543 = True
Makoto has returned to class!
lines.zh: Makoto 回班了！

lines.en: But she still isn’t ready for things to go back to normal.
lines.zh: 但她还没准备好让一切回到正轨。

lines.en: What if she never is?
lines.zh: 要是她永远都准备不好呢？

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
